Monthly notice for a hopeful period
Please take a moment

Travelers should review the latest guidance for companion animal arrangements before departing with Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

This notice reminds travelers to confirm carrier readiness, pet documents, and airport check-in details before travel. The desk welcomes questions in a warm professional tone, and the service treats each journey as a shared responsibility. Please keep all animal records easy to present and make sure feeding, comfort, and handling needs are considered in advance.

If a disruption affects your onward journey, the desk will guide you through the next steps and record the details needed for review. <<FACT F110>> Keep all travel papers together and report any concern as soon as possible so the team can assist without delay.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure for clear advice and practical support.
